en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a European town square with historic buildings. In the center background is a large, ornate building with a prominent tower featuring a clock and a decorative spire. The square is populated by people in early 20th-century attire, including a man with a cart and others walking. The architecture has Dutch gables and detailing. The bottom of the postcard contains printed text.
